questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
Career opportunities, Explore new cultures and Personal connection to the destination. 

Career opportunities because I have a dream to work as a translator

 Explore new cultures such as living in one of the biggest cities in europe

Personal connection to the destination because I have family in france and would've liked to connect with them.
